lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi pp. 40-43, Steps 1 to 5, and p. 46, Worksheet A, line 2. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/eic.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 140 partial records; 2,135 comparisons): 1,945 of 2,135 agree; differences 59 candidate-unknown, 51 project-unknown, 51 value, 24 candidate-refuses, 5 project-refuses; on returns the full interview completes: 19 value, 1 candidate-unknown. Completed-return witnesses were listed with the witness cap lifted (triage.mjs run directly; scratch /tmp/adj-bklg-dems/eic.full.json, rerun minutes later while concurrent class M runs were rewriting fixtures/2025/classm*.json, so its counts can differ from the record by a few class M records). On classm.asset.1 (a completed return the project ends at an earlier STOP) the candidate is unknown for dependent.kidnapped, which the project and the interview do not ask there; a candidate that needs an answer the source does not need is a model error (README). The value differences are all on completed returns with no earned income for the credit (Worksheet A line 2 or Worksheet B line 4b zero, "STOP You can't take the credit"): classm.f1040.4, classm.f1040.4.deepseek, classm.f8863.2, classm.f8863.2.deepseek, classm.sli.4, classm.ssb.4, stage14.s8812.eiw_stop_with_se_tax, stage14.s8812.eiw_zero_with_se_tax, stage14.eic.wsb_stop_27c, generated 143, 170, 238, 242, 253, 254, 261, 355, 405, 412 and two partial records of classm.f8863.2.deepseek. The id eic.eligible is a project interface (the prompt lists it without a definition and says "These names are not instructions for how to compute them"); the source has no quantity of that name. The project's reading (label "Steps 1 to 5 passed in order") leaves the worksheet STOPs to eic.line6, and eic.credit agrees on every completed return, so no eic amount differs. The candidate folds the worksheet STOP into the test. The difference does reach a printed result through the backlog package's new gate household.eic_disallowed_claim (household.credit_disallowed and eic.eligible): with the Form 8862 answer Yes, classm.ssb.4 and stage14.eic.wsb_stop_27c, whose EIC is $0, are refused at eic.credit and Form 1040 lines 27a, 34 and 37 (evaluated). i1040gi p. 43: "You must file Form 8862 if your EIC for a year after 1996 was reduced or disallowed", that is, to take the credit, and these filers cannot take it. Finding F1 (`.transcription/proposed/bklg/eic.findings.md`): the gate should read the credit figured (eic.line6 above zero), not eic.eligible. Project's eic.eligible stands as labelled; the finding is in the gate that reads it.
